item.title: Version 1.4.3
item.description:
Changed

  • vSnapshot's "Size MiB" column now says what it doesn't include. It's always been this snapshot's own data + memory file size, deliberately excluding the disk delta chain (attributing how much of a chain's cumulative size belongs to any one snapshot isn't well-defined without guessing) — every number was real, never estimated, but that caveat lived only in a code comment, not anywhere a user looking at the table would see it. The column header now reads "Size MiB (excl. deltas)" so a capacity decision made from this column alone isn't made on a false assumption of completeness.
